stem:
Students view two different cells under a microscope. They record their observations in the table shown.

Based on the organelles observed, the students determine that cell 2 is a plant cell because it has an organelle that —

options.label: A
options.text: allows water to enter and exit the cell

visual_elements:
A table with 2 columns and 3 rows
Column headers: Cell | Organelles Observed
Row 1: 1 | Vacuoles, Nucleus, Cell Membrane
Row 2: 2 | Vacuoles, Nucleus, Chloroplast, Cell Wall
